item.title: AWS User Group La Paz - DevOps Bootcamp
item.description:
The AWS User Group La Paz during June and July of 2026, organized the first DevOps Bootcamp in Bolivia, which is open and free for the community! The idea of this bootcamp was to reach professionals and students who are interested in learning more about the DevSecOps culture and its principles, and to put them into practice, 100% hands-on using AWS and other technologies widely used in the industry.
